lines.en: I walk the corridor on tiptoe.

lines.zh: 我走过来没有一点声响
lines.en: I cross the floor without a sound.

lines.zh: 我从门后一点点挪出来
lines.en: I ease out from behind the door.
I lean forward with my head tilted.
I creep inch by inch along the baseboard.
I slip past the security camera.

lines.zh: 我半透明的身子晃了晃
lines.en: My translucent body flickers.
I turn at the end of the hall.
One block nearer, then another.
I do not run, nor hurry.
My balloon bobs behind me.
I drift a short way.
I slip out of the dark corner.

lines.zh: 我转向离你更近的那边
lines.en: I turn toward your side.
I drag a step at a time.
My face stays turned to you.
I hang in the middle of the hall.
I tilt my head and stay still.
My balloon does not drift off.
My translucent body flickers.
The tube light buzzes beside me.
I look down the corridor.
My expression never drops.
I am quiet, without breath.
I turn slowly on the spot.
Both my hands hang down.

lines.zh: 地上几乎找不到我的影子
lines.en: My shadow is nearly gone.
I wait for movement in the hall.
I lift that face to you.
I do not blink.
My face is right in front of you.
Did you hear me laugh?
My head tips slowly aside.
I will not chase if you back off.
My balloon is still beside you.
I stare at you, unmoving.
I see you clearly under the light.
I do not speak, only smile.
My shape flickers.
The torn part closes over.
I do not cry out.
My smile fades a moment.
I drift half a block back.
The lights stutter above me.
My neck angles further over.
My balloon swings wildly.
I take shape again, slowly.
One scream, then I'm gone.
You wave that thing about.
I neither eat nor take.
I float past it.
There is nothing I mean to take.
Holding it will change nothing.
My eyes have not moved.

lines.zh: 气球线还在你手里，我不看。
lines.en: The balloon string is in your hand; I don't look.
I keep watching you.
Put it down.
That is not why I came.
You hit me and I scatter.
The scatter of me knits back.
My hand brushes your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你穿过我，只带走一阵凉。
lines.en: You pass through me, taking only a chill.

lines.zh: 你从我身体里穿过去了
lines.en: You passed through me.
I feel no pain.

lines.zh: 地上那道影子一亮一灭
lines.en: The shadow on the floor blinks.
I withdraw a little way.
What you touched is cold.
I drift back to where I was.
Another one comes out of the wall.

lines.zh: 我们两个一同悬在半空
lines.en: The two of us hang in the air.
Its smile matches mine.
We tip toward the same side.
Our balloons bump.
We turn to you as one.

lines.zh: 墙里那个影子，颜色比我还浅。
lines.en: The shape in the wall is paler than I am.
Neither of us laughs aloud.
We drift your way together.
Two shadows lie along the hall.
Something drops at my feet.

lines.zh: 地上的糖纸映出我半透明的脸。
lines.en: The candy wrapper on the floor reflects my translucent face.
It slips down through my palm.
My hand cannot hold it.
It rests in my aura.
I give it a shove.
It turns cold.
I watch it roll away.
I leave it alone.
It casts no shadow down there.
I straighten my head.
The hall light dims a notch.
I reach out toward you.
My smile splits wider.
I fix on you and hold.
I stop moving slowly.
I drift one block closer.
The air chills around me.
I start toward you.
I do not intend to stop.
I know where you are.
I raise a hand slowly.
I drift low across the floor.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪边我都看得见
lines.en: I see wherever you run.

lines.zh: 气球男孩，从侧面探出头。
lines.en: Balloon Boy pokes his head out from your side.

lines.zh: 我在等你的手离开按钮
lines.en: I wait for your hand to leave the button.
My balloon arrives first.
Back one block and I fill it.
No rush; the hall is long.

lines.zh: 我带着气球，飘到你背后
lines.en: Balloon in hand, I drift behind you
I tilt my head lower.
Only two steps separate us.
I wait for you to turn around.
My body wavers bright and dim.
I reach for your shoulder.
The moment I touch, I scream.
That face presses to your eyes.
I snatch once and pull back.

lines.zh: 我的手透过了你的胳膊
lines.en: My hand goes through your arm.
Fear pushes you half a step back.
I press up behind you.

lines.zh: 我的尖叫在走廊里回荡
lines.en: My scream echoes down the hall.
I lunge and vanish.

lines.zh: 你听见的最后一句话是我的笑
lines.en: My laugh is the last thing you hear.
The hall lights start to flicker.
I fade in out of the wall.
My shadow spreads on the floor first.
I appear with my head tilted.
The air chills all around.
A balloon trails from my hand.
I stand in the camera's blind spot.
A shadow appears at the hall's end.

lines.zh: 我的颜色淡得几乎看不见
lines.en: I am so faint you barely see me.
I arrive without one sound.
Fire lights my face; I fade.
I drop from a height.
Water passes straight through me.

lines.zh: 气浪一过，我薄得像层烟。
lines.en: After the blast, I'm thin as smoke.
Something passes through my chest.
Spell light tears my shape open.
I never hunger; I only fade.

lines.zh: 雷光里我的影子很清楚
lines.en: In the lightning my shadow shows.
The dark swallows me too.
